scope: Actual synthetic JWT admin ASGI to authenticated native ASGI metadata only; no tasks or feature configuration writes, real patients or hospital backend

objectives.all_required_then_min_declared_cost: Required cases hard; minimize exact nonnegative declared total penalty, optional deferral remains a choice.
objectives.max_optional_scheduled_then_min_declared: Required cases hard; maximize optional scheduled count then minimize declared penalty lexicographically.

recipe.intervals: Exact UTC microseconds; [start,end); explicit zero has no occupancy; reversed original segment is a violated candidate fact, never swapped.
recipe.accounting: Exact integer microseconds; original minutes multiply by 60000000 without floating point. Rolling 24h and 7d extrema use all interval endpoint and shifted-endpoint breakpoints; fixed windows are separate rules.
recipe.search: Deterministic factorized best-bound binary sibling-range cursor; no Cartesian expansion or dominance. Complete parent remains until decision child and remaining range are both committed/closed. Budget interrupt retains the complete original parent bound.
recipe.bounds: Only irrevocable separable cost plus independent remaining minima; unknown nonnegative cost has lower bound zero. Optional upper bound counts all remaining possible optional cases. No partial sequence/minimum-work/rest-grouping pruning. Global optimistic bound includes all frontier and complete optimistic incumbent.
recipe.graphs: Definite complete leaves require all hard checks satisfied; optimistic relaxes unknown constraints while preserving a true supergraph. Incomplete underlying domains force input_unknown rather than global proof. Optimistic candidate never becomes executable solution.

operations.grammar: One source/factor/constraint scalar visit, option-bound contribution, interval overlap/endpoint contribution, qualification/availability/policy contribution or leaf check is one charged operation; repeated scans and every canonical check record's structural/scalar values charge per member. Hash/UTF8/parse have separate fixed byte/count limits. Interrupt during a leaf/bound leaves that node unclassified with its original admissible bound.

recipe.order: Required cases then factor-domain cardinality then case UUID; schedule before defer; chronological starts, UUID resource/duty choices, slot keys; best bound then deeper decision before range then deterministic serial.
recipe.verification: All cohort persons' work rules including unselected fixed-window minima, all declared resource final timelines including fixed busy transition costs, selected constraints, search operations, frontier, objectives and fixed explanation are recomputed from the complete public source; digest-only validation is insufficient.

input_policy.identity: Problem-local canonical UUIDs; exact current private raw-to-capsule-to-public projection is verified by the application, never inferred from hashes alone.
input_policy.privacy: No patient/admission/User/Doctor/equipment database keys, names, diagnoses, operation titles, notes or original question. Cross-scope busy capsules preserve operational facts and raw digests under separate raw-audit authorization.
input_policy.availability: Original recorded_at <= published_at <= as_of; all known clocks remain UTC6. No historical backfill or guessed naive timezone. Explicit IANA day bounds; overflow/nonexistent/ambiguous midnight is rejected.
input_policy.missing: Zero/false/null remain distinct. Unknown timing, capacity, qualification, identity, policy, busy, requirement or domain closure is never a normal/default fact.
input_policy.domains: All reviewed finite starts and demand resource/duty choices are complete and factorized. Incomplete case/resource/start domains cannot prove global infeasibility or optimality. No hidden time grid, truncation or invented external resource.
input_policy.timing: Only reviewed case estimates or unknown; no unimplemented statistical estimator. Signed exact microseconds, explicit zero segments, positive main-room occupancy; upper/point durations are declared conditions, not clinical guarantees.
input_policy.resources: Patient presence is independent of room. One concrete asset per equipment quantity slot. Different role/equipment demands cannot union away quantity; same-demand stages union or envelope only as explicitly declared.
input_policy.person_qualification: Each person role needs at least one explicitly reviewed authorization capability hash supported over every occupied interval by actual effective qualification facts. Empty role capability requirements mean unknown, never authorized by identity, role_kind, platform role or title alone.
input_policy.work: Reviewed explicit duty membership only. Duty baseline and selected counted work use interval union, never double-count. Confirmed non-work break vs counted surgery is a conflicting original, not overwritten. Rest applies between distinct explicit duties; full duty span defines maximum presence. All-location duty/work prefix/suffix coverage is required. Applicable policies are conjunctive; absent policy is unknown unless explicitly reviewed not required.
input_policy.sequence: Extra transitions are separate from declared intrinsic stages. Missing directed pair is unknown, not zero. Partial adjacency gap/cost is not monotone. Optimistic unknown occupancy/status/identity that can change adjacency relaxes the affected resource's extra transition gaps and costs together; cost lower bound zero. Known hard overlaps and identities remain enforced.
input_policy.scope: Only the declared closed case/resource/period/policy problem; no hospital-wide or real booking guarantee. Candidate output never creates a reservation or changes clinical state.
